title: Adaptive Chosen-Ciphertext Bound for LRW2 Cascades
summary: For s-fold LRW2 cascades, security is proven up to 2 raised to sn/(s+2) queries; whether it reaches 2 raised to sn/(s+1) queries remains open.

formal_statement.body: Show whether an $s$-fold LRW2 cascade is secure against adaptive chosen-ciphertext adversaries up to $2^{sn/(s+1)}$ queries, improving the proven $2^{sn/(s+2)}$ bound.

scope.domain: Adaptive chosen-ciphertext security bounds for s-fold LRW2 tweakable-blockcipher cascades.
assumptions: The attack model permits adaptive chosen-ciphertext queries.
parameters: s: number of LRW2 evaluations in the cascade
n: parameter governing the exponent in both query bounds
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether security can be strengthened from the proven 2 raised to sn/(s+2) queries to 2 raised to sn/(s+1) queries in the same attack model.

citations.label: How to Build Fully Secure Tweakable Blockciphers from Classical Blockciphers

progress.summary: The source presents the sn/(s+2) exponent as proven by prior work and the stronger sn/(s+1) exponent as conjectured for adaptive chosen-ciphertext adversaries. It does not resolve the conjecture.
citation_labels: Lei Wang et al., How to Build Fully Secure Tweakable Blockciphers from Classical Blockciphers
